purpose: Machine-readable county-to-EFCA-district territory assignment used to build us_view_hazard_profiles.json. Companion to district_boundary_crosswalk.md (the human-readable writeup with sourcing/confidence notes per state) and us_view_mockup.html (the visual mockup this feeds).
how_to_read: For each district: 'whole_states' lists states/territories assigned entirely to that district. 'partial_states' lists, for states split between multiple districts, the specific county list assigned to THIS district (county names match FEMA NRI's COUNTY field format — no 'County'/'Parish' suffix). Where a partial_states entry says 'exact_list_not_archived', that district's hazard numbers in us_view_hazard_profiles.json are still real and verified (they were computed at fetch time), but the specific county list used for that one state fragment wasn't saved separately — see notes.

North Central: Minnesota (all except the 4 counties listed under Northern Plains' Minnesota entry below)
whole_state_assignments.Midwest_note: Simplification: EFCA's own description also gives Midwest a 'Kansas City metro, Missouri' pocket, which we folded into EFCA Central's whole-Missouri assignment rather than carving out specific KC-metro counties. See district_boundary_crosswalk.md.

Maryland.Allegheny: exact_list_not_archived (evidence: only Garrett County/Mountain Lake Park confirmed; hazard total for Allegheny includes an assumed small MD panhandle share)

New York.Allegheny: exact_list_not_archived (evidence: Rochester/Buffalo corridor confirmed; hazard total for Allegheny includes an assumed western-NY share)

Kentucky.EFCA Southeast: all counties except the 7 listed under Great Lakes below (113 counties)

Ohio.Allegheny: exact_list_not_archived (all remaining ~50 Ohio counties; hazard total for Allegheny includes this full remainder)

Michigan.Great Lakes: all Lower Peninsula counties, plus these eastern Upper Peninsula counties: Marquette, Alger, Schoolcraft, Luce, Chippewa, Mackinac, Delta (per official description 'Lower Peninsula and Eastern Upper')

South Dakota.Rocky Mountain: exact_list_not_archived (western SD / Black Hills counties, ~22 counties incl. Custer, Fall River, Haakon, Meade, Pennington)
South Dakota.note: Central SD (Hughes, Stanley, Jackson, Lyman, Tripp, Gregory, Mellette, Todd, Bennett) has no confirmed church evidence for any of the 3 districts — a genuine gap, not assigned here.

Montana.Inland Mountain: exact_list_not_archived (all remaining ~55 Montana counties; hazard total for Inland Mountain includes this full remainder)

Nevada.note: 9 remaining rural central-NV counties have no confirmed church evidence for either district — a genuine gap, not assigned here.

Minnesota.note: Karlstad (Marshall County) is a contested dual-claim in the source evidence — see district_boundary_crosswalk.md.

known_gaps: Allegheny's exact Ohio/Maryland/New York county lists were used to compute its hazard numbers at fetch time but weren't separately archived — only Pennsylvania's Allegheny/EFCA East split (above) is fully preserved for that district.
Inland Mountain's exact Montana county list (beyond Washington and Idaho, both fully archived above) wasn't separately preserved.
Rocky Mountain's exact South Dakota county list wasn't separately preserved (South Dakota's EFCA Central and Northern Plains shares are fully archived above).

If exact reproduction of these three fragments matters later, the fix is a fresh, tightly-scoped re-fetch using the same method documented in us_view_hazard_profiles.json's methodology note — not a guess.
